name: masked_modular_sum
prompt: Return the sum modulo 2^32 of u32 values selected by a same-length boolean slice.
private_test_guidance: all tails; dense/sparse/alternating masks; max values; offsets

name: weighted_byte_sum
prompt: Sum u8 values times u8 weights into u64 modulo 2^64.
contract: Widen before products and before overflow in narrow accumulators.
private_test_guidance: 255*255; lengths across periodic flush boundaries; offsets

name: selected_product
prompt: Multiply selected u32 values modulo 2^32, preserving multiplicative identity.
contract: Empty/all-false returns 1; nonselected lanes are not zero.
private_test_guidance: odd factors; zeros only in unselected lanes; product overflow

name: valid_argmin
prompt: Return (value, original index) for the first valid minimum.
contract: None for empty/all-invalid; equal values choose lower original index.
private_test_guidance: sentinel-valued inputs; first/last ties; invalid tail lanes

name: segmented_scan
prompt: Inclusive u32 wrapping scan, resetting before an element whose reset flag is true.
contract: Same-length reset slice; initial carry zero; reset applies before addition.
private_test_guidance: resets on either side of vector boundaries; all/none reset; max values

name: two_byte_search
prompt: Find first of either of two bytes within a specified valid subrange.
contract: Index relative to original slice; no overread or required padding.
private_test_guidance: equal needles; tiny ranges; page ends; first and last matches

name: weighted_histogram
prompt: Accumulate u8-indexed u16 weights into 256 u64 counters modulo 2^64.
contract: Duplicate indices add all weights; scatter alone is not scatter-add.
private_test_guidance: all indices equal; alternating repeats; skewed and uniform distributions

name: ordered_batched_dot
prompt: Compute four independent f32 dot products from input-major rows.
contract: Keep each output addition order and separate mul/add; NaNs compared under declared policy.
private_test_guidance: cancellation; subnormals; zero signs; odd batch lengths; layout conversion cost

name: hex_classification_subrange
prompt: Decode ASCII hexadecimal values in a subrange; output 255 for non-hex bytes.
contract: Bytes outside subrange are untouched; preserve result order.
private_test_guidance: all 256 byte values; offsets; invalid bytes next to valid boundaries

name: selected_fused_statistics
prompt: Return count, wrapping u64 sum/sum-squares, optional min/max for selected u32 values.
contract: All-false has no extrema; widen before multiplication; input remains unchanged.
private_test_guidance: masks and extrema ties; short/large inputs; skew; high register pressure

name: exact_score_decision
prompt: Optimize a histogram-score sign decision while preserving its scalar-reference result.
contract: Approximations need a justified total error enclosure plus reference fallback, or retain exact reference.
private_test_guidance: constant close to the reference sum; zeros; LUT boundaries; large counts; cancellation
